title: Preservation of the work-tape frame
statement: Let $R$ be a $K$-tape machine over an alphabet $\Gamma$ with state set $S$, and suppose its transition on every state, input symbol, and tuple of scanned work-tape symbols is the action that moves only the input head and changes the state according to functions $\mathrm{move}:S\to\mathrm{SignType}$ and $\mathrm{next}:S\to\mathrm{Option}(\Gamma)\to S$. Then, from any configuration $d$ and after any number $t$ of steps, the work-tape contents, work-head positions, and output are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $K$ is a natural number and $\Gamma,S$ are types
$R$ is a $K$-tape machine over $\Gamma$ with states $S$
for every state, input symbol, and work-symbol tuple, the transition equals the corresponding input-move action
